build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs in modwerk-source-tools): the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45, vendored) + this folder's comp-preview 1.1.0, materialised against stock OS 1.74 (cb0f99d6…e123), --version CP11

emulator.name: analog-emu (trigcondition's Rytm and A4 emulator built on rytm-emu; its history holds rytm-emu c5732f0, 951dcbc and e914f46)
emulator.settings: no card image, JIT on, --every 1000M; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; short presses (12M) select the FX track and open its AMP page (the compressor); encoder 0 (THR) turns down thirty-eight steps to 64; AMP again opens the preview; BD is struck ten times, 300M apart; FUNC is held while AMP is pressed for the second layout, and BD is struck ten times more. Stock 1.74 with the same input gives byte-identical frames up to the compressor page and stays on it when AMP is pressed again. Below THR about 45 the estimate holds a large reduction between hits in the emulator, so the full layout's trace leaves the screen; the captures use 64. Playback was not judged in the emulator.
